US Officials Question Nvidia Chip Sales to China Amid Spy Concerns

US officials are seeking information regarding Nvidia's sale of advanced chips to China, with concerns raised that China's spy agency may have conducted a two-year campaign to acquire these chips. Senator John Kennedy has specifically urged scrutiny of Howard Lutnick, suggesting he should cease providing AI chips to China if that is the case. Director of National Intelligence (DNI) Avril Haines stated that China likely obtained Nvidia AI chips, and a report suggests the possibility of a two-year campaign by China's spy agency to smuggle them. The US is seeking answers on these sales.
